Group

class Group(*args: T, **kwargs: T)[source]

Bases: object

A class to define Groups of Agent objects that can serve as a way of clustering hierarchies, and providing a pseudo-vectorisation of model operations across agents.

Supported positional arguments:

  • <string> to set the Group’s id.

  • <int> to set the Group’s maximum size.

Parameters:

  • id (str, optional) – Positional argument – provides a unique identifier for a group.

  • max_size (int, optional) – Positional argument – the maximum number of Agents that can be members of this group.

  • index (int, optional) – Keyword argument – the group’s index within a GroupSet.

  • hierarchy (str, optional) – Keyword argument – the social hierarchy that this group is being formed in.

  • members (list[str], optional) – Keyword argument – the IDs of the agents that are members of this group.

  • aggregate_opinion (float, optional) – Keyword argument – the aggregate opinion held by members of the group.

  • aggregate_susceptibility (float, optional) – Keyword argument – the aggregate social susceptibility of group members.

  • cohesion (str, optional) – Keyword argument – the level of cohesion that the group will act with.

  • radicalisation_rate (float, optional) – Keyword argument – The proportion of agents in the group which are radicalised.

  • predominant_personality (str, optional) – Keyword argument – The most common personality type among members in the group.

  • member_benefit_rate (float, optional) – Keyword argument – The proportion of agents in the groups which are personally benefitted from the social contagion.

  • previous_opinion (float, optional) – Keyword argument – The aggregate opinion held by the group at the immediate past iteration.

  • aggregate_hierarchy_weighting (float, optional) – Keyword argument – The aggregate weighting that the members of the group give to the hierarchy they are in.

Methods

add_attribute

Dynamically add an attribute to this Group object.

add_member

Add a new member to this group (using the Agent's ID as the identifier).

add_members

Add multiple new members to this group (using the Agent IDs as the identifiers).

change_aggregate_opinion

A setter method that changes the Group's aggregate opinion by a given delta value.

determine_predominant_personality

A setter method that will determine what the predominant personality type amongst group members is.

generate_group

Generate a Group object based on the input parameters.

get_attribute

Return any existing or dynamically added attribute held by the Group object.

get_num_members

A getter method that reports the number of members that are contained in this Group.

group_at_capacity

A function that reports if the group is at its maximum capacity.

is_radicalised

A function that reports if the group is considered to be "radicalised" as a collective.

recalculate_aggregate_opinion

A setter method that will calculate a fixed aggregate opinion value from the currently held opinion values of members.

recalculate_hierarchy_weighting

A setter method that will calculate a fixed member hierarchy weighting value from the current hierarchy weightings assigned by each group member.

recalculate_member_benefit_rate

A setter method that will calculate a fixed member benefit rate value from the current personal benefit statuses of group members.

recalculate_radicalisation_rate

A setter method that will calculate a fixed radicalisation rate value from the current radicalisation statuses of group members.

set_cohesion

A setter function to change the group's cohesion type.

set_hierarchy

A setter function to change the hierarchy that the Group belongs to.

set_index

A setter function to change the Group's index.

set_max_size

A setter function to change the maximum size of a Group.

store_previous_opinion

A setter method that stores the Group's current opinion into the previous opinion.
